entries.1ba34e7b0d4fbb6a: As its corporate philosophy, the company aims to become a company that provides services of encounter, conversation, relaxation and healing to local communities through heart, food and drink, and that is thanked by customers around the world. In the medium to long term, it places importance on sixth-industry initiatives as a “food sixth-industry company” that operates primary (production), secondary (processing) and tertiary (store sales) industries in-house, and its policy is to develop stores that are chosen for improvements in QSCA (quality, service, cleanliness and atmosphere). Its current slogan is “Courage to change, readiness to be changed. Creating the number one local restaurant together,” and the company says it is focusing on strategies to raise store profitability, expanding specialized formats, opening new stores and converting formats, and enabling diverse human resources to thrive.

entries.9481f712c580543e: This business operates restaurants centered on izakaya (Japanese-style pubs). It operates under formats including 'Hana no Mai' and 'Sakanaya Dojo', with directly operated stores run by the company and franchised stores run by owners under franchise agreements; as of the end of March 2026, the company had 202 directly operated stores and 140 franchised stores, a total of 342 stores. Store product supply is supported by fresh fish procured using bidding rights at Toyosu Market, produce from farmers with whom it has direct contracts, a procurement network through the consolidated subsidiary Ota Ichiba Chimney Co., Ltd., located within the Ota Market of the Tokyo Metropolitan Central Wholesale Market, and a logistics network centered on logistics bases in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture and 3 other locations. In franchising, the company adopts the 'Tatedate System', under which the operation of stores previously run directly by the company is transferred to owners. The consolidated subsidiaries Beni Fuzu Kopore-shon Co., Ltd. (including 'Shimbashi Yakiton', 19 stores) and Meccha Sakana ga Suki Co., Ltd. (including 'Toyomaru', 9 stores) also operate restaurants, and the equity-method affiliate Tsubohachi Co., Ltd. also runs a food and beverage business.
